title: Topic icons
chooser-help: Users pick from the library only; they cannot upload their own images. Changing or removing the icon later follows the same rule, and only the topic author or a moderator can do it.
show-in-topic: Show the icon in the topic header
default-icon-help: Shown for topics without an icon, unless their category has its own default.
covers-help: A topic without its own thumbnail can show the first image of its first post or the default cover of its category, in that order. Covers are added when topics are shown, not saved in them: changing a category cover takes effect everywhere at once, and a topic whose image is edited out loses it right away. Topics with thumbnails added by their authors keep them.
cover-category: Show the category's default cover on topics without one
cover-auto: Use the first image of the first post as the cover
cover-external: Also use images from other sites (http/https)
cover-external-help: Off: only images uploaded to this forum are used. On: every visitor's browser loads the image from the other site, which then sees their IP address, and the image may disappear or change there.
cover-style: Uniform frame for topic thumbnails (cropped to the ratio below, rounded corners)
cover-phones: Show thumbnails in topic lists on phones as well
library-help: Order is the order in the picker. An icon limited to no category is offered everywhere; a topic moved to a category where its icon is not available loses it. Switched-off icons are no longer offered, but topics that already use them keep them. Removing an icon takes it off its topics when you save (the category default is shown instead) and deletes its uploaded image. Images: PNG, WebP or SVG, up to %1 KB; square images of 64×64 px or more look best. Images from other sites (https) are loaded by every visitor's browser from that site.
empty-library: The library is empty. Add an icon or restore the built-in ones.
category-defaults-help: Icon shown for topics in a category when the author did not pick one.
category-covers-help: The default cover is shown on topics without a thumbnail and without an image in the first post. Images: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to %1 KB, or a site path / https URL; landscape images of 640×480 px or more look best.
confirm-remove: Remove the icon “%1”? When you save, topics that use it lose it (the category default is shown instead) and its uploaded image is deleted.
confirm-restore: Add the built-in icons that are missing from the library?
restored: Built-in icons added. Save to keep the change.
save-blocked: The settings could not be loaded, so saving is disabled to avoid overwriting them.
uploaded: Image uploaded. Save to keep the change.
upload-type: Only PNG, WebP and SVG images are accepted, and the content must match the file extension.
upload-size: The image is too large (at most %1 KB).
upload-svg-unsafe: This SVG contains scripts, event handlers or external links and was refused.
cover-upload-type: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and SVG images are accepted, and the content must match the file extension.
error.icons-json: The icon library is not valid JSON.
error.row-id: Icon %1: invalid id (lower-case letters, digits and dashes).
error.row-duplicate: Icon %1: the id is used twice.
error.row-url: Icon %1: the image must be a site path (/…) or an https URL ending in .png, .webp or .svg.
error.row-name: Icon %1: the name is longer than %2 characters.
error.chooser: Unknown value of “Who can choose an icon”.
error.chooser-group: Choose the group whose members can pick icons.
error.chooser-group-missing: The group chosen in “Who can choose an icon” does not exist. Choose an existing group.
error.chooser-group-invalid: This group cannot be used in “Who can choose an icon”. Choose another group.
error.default-unknown: The forum-wide default icon is not in the library.
error.category-defaults: The category defaults are not valid JSON.
error.category-default-unknown: The default icon of category %1 is not in the library.
error.category-covers: The category covers are not valid JSON.
error.category-cover-url: Category %1: the cover must be a site path (/…) or an https URL ending in .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif or .svg.
